surfaces.name: extension_identity_hash
surfaces.detection_basis: AST: hashlib.sha256 together with extension-directory traversal (rglob/glob/os.walk) and file reads; owner calls are not matches.
surfaces.guidance: 调用 browser_extension_sync.extension_file_hashes，不要复制扩展目录遍历和哈希规则。

surfaces.name: opencli_patch_registration
surfaces.detection_basis: AST: a multi-field patch table containing original/replacement and count/version data combined with source.replace/count editing; owner calls are not matches.
surfaces.guidance: 追加补丁必须登记到 runtime/opencli_patches.py，并由生成器写入 vendor 产物。

surfaces.name: user_preference_write
surfaces.detection_basis: AST: a preferences.json path literal combined with write_text/json.dump/open or equivalent write call; importing and calling save_preferences is allowed.
surfaces.guidance: 调用 core.preferences.save_preferences，不要在其他模块直接写 preferences.json。

surfaces.name: process_startup
surfaces.detection_basis: AST: subprocess.Popen (including an imported or aliased Popen) outside the registered lifecycle modules; owner calls are not matches.
surfaces.guidance: 进程只能在现有允许模块启动，并使用受管生命周期入口。

surfaces.name: completeness_summary
surfaces.detection_basis: AST: multiple Check/status values are reduced to downgrade/ok/unknown through any/all or conditional aggregation; collection completeness_counts is not this surface.
surfaces.guidance: 单条内容完整度统一调用 core.completeness.check_completeness，不要在其他模块合成 Check 状态。

surfaces.name: ai_chat_title_cleaning
surfaces.detection_basis: AST: re.sub suffix removal with an end anchor and a site-name alias (for example 豆包 or Google Gemini); owner calls are not matches.
surfaces.guidance: AI 对话标题清洗统一调用 core.chat_title.clean_chat_title。
